en.hubeali:
Al Sayyari, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘The lowest of the sauce is to cut the bread with the knife’.
en.sarwar: 10. Al-Sayyariy in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the least of curry is to cut the bread with a knife.’”
